**Location**: This role is hybrid in-office 3x a week out of our Williamsburg, Brooklyn or SF offices!

**About Swayable**

Swayable is a fast-growing AI and automated data science platform that measures public opinion, and the impact of messages and advertising content on it. We are a 50-person team backed by top technology and social impact investors, including Y Combinator. Founded in 2018 by physics PhDs, it is led by the former Executive Director for Digital Strategy at the New York Times. Clients include major consumer-facing brands (JP Morgan Chase, Airbnb, Paramount Pictures), technology companies (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon), academic researchers (MIT, Yale, Stanford) and mission-aligned civic advocacy campaigns (e.g. on climate, human rights and elections). Check our our values & culture deck to learn more: [https://tinyurl.com/4zjchwzs](https://tinyurl.com/4zjchwzs)

Joining Swayable means being on a team whose work changes the course of history. The technology we develop is at the leading edge of transforming some of the world’s most important campaign organizations and enterprises: combatting disinformation, protecting democracy, and supporting the sustainable growth of consumer-facing brands.

**About the Role**You’ll own a portfolio of product bets—new capabilities we’re investing in to expand what the Swayable platform does and deepen its value to clients—along with a set of features on our core content-testing product. You’ll bring a general manager’s mindset: you’re accountable not just for shipping, but for adoption, usage, growth, and go-to-market success—taking each bet from prototype to research preview to beta, and making clear, evidence-based go/no-go calls along the way.

Great product starts with deep client understanding and rigorous user research. You’ll earn the kind of trust where clients invite you to shadow their teams, and you’ll recruit and research users beyond our existing clients to find the problems worth solving. From there, you’ll build and test prototypes quickly—starting with what works, putting it in front of real users, measuring, and iterating.

You’ll lead how we build: partnering with engineering to shape Swayable’s AI software factory—the agents, evaluation harnesses, workflows, and tooling behind our AI software development lifecycle—so the whole team ships faster without sacrificing architectural integrity.

You’ll also bring ideas from the broader AI community—identifying groundbreaking techniques, sharing them internally, and keeping Swayable at the cutting edge of applied AI.

**What You'll Do**

* Own a portfolio of product bets plus features on the core product. Prioritize them against the company’s business objectives, and own outcomes, not just delivery.
* Take each bet through prototype, research preview, and beta: validate the problem, size the prize, build a minimum lovable product, test willingness to pay, and make a clear go/no-go call at each gate.
* Build trust-based relationships with clients deep enough to shadow their teams, understand their workflows firsthand, and identify problems they haven’t yet articulated.
* Recruit users beyond our client base and run your own research—interviews, contextual inquiry, usability tests—to understand their problems with the same depth.
* Rapidly prototype, test ideas empirically with real users, start with what works, and iterate based on evidence.
* Design, build, and evaluate complex agents—multi-step reasoning, tool use, orchestration—and integrate them into intelligent, intuitive user experiences. Define evals and quality bars, and drive continuous improvement in output quality.
* Lead the AI software development lifecycle with engineering, including building Swayable’s AI software factory: the agents, evals, and tooling that accelerate how we build every product.
* Use data and analytics to inform decision-making and iterate quickly.
* Partner with sales and customer success to drive go-to-market —validation, positioning, pricing and packaging, launch, onboarding, and adoption.
* Collaborate tightly with engineering, design, data science, and customer success—prioritizing action over process.
* Engage with the AI community to stay up to date on the latest advancements, and share knowledge with the organization.

**Who You Are**

* 3+ years of relevant professional experience and a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
* Clear, effective communication, both written and verbal.
* Track record of building trusted relationships with clients or users—ideally to the point of being invited to shadow their work—and turning that context into products they adopt.
* Evidence of recruiting users and running research yourself, and using it to find problems worth solving.
* Evidence of rapid, empirical iteration: prototypes put in front of users, measured, and improved or killed quickly.
* Blend of analytical and design thinking—you use data to understand problems and judge what’s working, and apply design thinking principles to reframe problems, ideate collaboratively, and shape creative solutions.
* Systems thinking—you see how clients, users, product, data, and go-to-market interact as one system, and design the whole, not just the feature.
* Have owned a product end to end, including its operational workflows and sales/marketing enablement, and were the person accountable for its outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience building LLM-based agentic systems—including evaluation frameworks—and integrating them into intelligent user experiences.
* Strong analytical judgment: you can frame the right question, tell whether an analysis is sound, catch flaws in AI-generated analysis, and derive clear decisions from analysis.
* Passionate about social impact and excited to help scale a platform that moves public opinion for good.

**Bonus**

* Experience owning a product line end to end including GTM outcomes.
* Experience at a high growth technology startup.
* Experience at a top-tier consulting firm or at a top-tier investment bank.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive base salary: $150-175K depending on experience and location
* Equity package
* Full healthcare coverage (no employee contribution required)
* 401K, generous PTO, and parental leave
* The chance to help build technology that matters—for business, democracy, and the world

**To Apply**

**Please send a brief note and evidence of extraordinary ability—CV, code, projects, or references. We especially want to see: (1) a complex agent you built, how you evaluated it, and how users interact with it; (2) a time you got close enough to a client or user to uncover a problem others missed; and (3) a product you were accountable for growing after launch—what you did and what happened.**

Swayable is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to promote an organizational environment that values diversity and fosters growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other basis prohibited by law. The team especially encourages applicants from underrepresented backgrounds.

**Globality is the autonomous sourcing platform to manage the entire intake to award process.**

At Globality, we build agentic technology that transforms how global enterprises source goods and services — autonomously, at scale, and without the inefficiencies that have defined procurement for decades. Our platform interprets purchase intent, generates sourcing materials, evaluates suppliers, and executes negotiation strategies without manual intervention.

**The Role**

As an AI Product Manager, you will own the  agent and AI layer of Glo, including the product decisions behind how it is designed and implemented, from agent architecture and orchestration to the interfaces that let customers, and their own agents, work with Glo. Your primary outcome is Glo's evolution to headless operation, where customers run sourcing entirely through the assistants and tools they already use, such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Slack, connected through agent interfaces like MCP. You will define how Glo's agents reason, use tools, coordinate with each other, and earn customer trust, and you will measure success by the outcomes customers achieve.

Every PM at Globality is a builder. You prototype ideas yourself using AI coding and design tools such as Claude Code, put working versions in front of customers, and partner directly with engineers to ship them. You work daily with Engineering, Design, and Customer teams, and you report into the Product organization.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for Glo's agent capabilities, setting priorities with company leadership and deciding what we build, what we stop, and what comes next.
* Lead Glo's evolution to headless operation by defining and shipping the MCP servers, APIs, and agent interfaces that let customers request, run, and approve sourcing events from Claude, ChatGPT, Slack, and the other tools they work in every day.
* Build working prototypes of new agent capabilities and workflows with tools such as Claude Code, and use them to test ideas with customers and engineers before committing to a full build.
* Write clear requirements and user stories for agent capabilities, orchestration, tool integrations, and interfaces, and work directly with engineers through delivery, testing builds, tuning prompts and evals, and contributing changes to the codebase where it speeds things up.
* Own the success metrics for Glo's agent capabilities, including task success, reliability, latency, cost per task, adoption, and the share of sourcing activity that runs through agent channels, and work with the product team to tie them to customer outcomes such as cycle time and savings.
* Set the bar for AI quality by defining evaluation criteria and release thresholds, building test sets with the Data Product Manager, reviewing agent outputs with sourcing domain experts, and monitoring performance in production.
* Gather insights from customer conversations, Customer Success, and usage data, and use them to decide where the product goes next.
* Work with Design to make agent decisions transparent and auditable to customers on every surface, from the Glo interface to conversations in Claude, ChatGPT, and Slack.
* Track the fast-moving agent ecosystem, including models, protocols, frameworks, and assistant platforms, and decide what Glo adopts, builds on, or builds itself.
* Lead launches end to end, including positioning, enablement, and customer communications.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a record of shipping and scaling B2B or enterprise software products
* 1+ years of experience building an AI enterprise product or an agentic platform, including taking AI features or agents from concept to production
* Working knowledge of how LLM-based systems behave, including prompting, tool use, retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, and failure modes, along with agent interfaces and protocols such as MCP and how products are used through assistants like Claude and ChatGPT
* Hands-on building experience. You regularly use AI coding and design tools such as Claude Code to build prototypes, internal tools, or product features, and you are comfortable working in a codebase alongside engineers. Links to things you've built are a strong plus
* Experience defining quality metrics and acceptance criteria for probabilistic systems, and using them to make release decisions
* Experience working with enterprise customers on requirements, security reviews, integrations, and adoption
* A track record of owning product outcomes end to end, making high-stakes calls amid ambiguity, and writing precise requirements that engineers can build from
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to align technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders
* Sourcing or procurement experience is welcome but not required, and you will work with domain experts to judge whether agent behavior is correct in real sourcing scenarios. We care most about depth in agentic AI and a track record of building.

**Why Globality**

**The opportunity is enormous.** Enterprise procurement is one of the last major business functions to be transformed by AI. We're not optimizing at the margins — we're fundamentally rethinking how trillions of dollars get spent.

**The team is world-class.** Our leadership team brings decades of experience from leading global enterprises, and our culture is built for people who want real ownership, not titles.

**You'll have real impact.** This isn't a role where you execute someone else's playbook. You'll shape the strategy, build the programs, and see the direct business impact of your work.

**We work together — literally.** We're in-office 4 days a week in Palo Alto because the best ideas – and the fastest decisions – happen face to face. One day is yours to work wherever you’re most effective.

*The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $250,000. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and location. This information is provided in accordance with the California Equal Pay Act. We are an equal opportunity employer and participate in the E-Verify program. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.*
